"title": "Cirrus Vision Jet Suffers Gear Collapse on Closed Runway in Idaho",
"summary": "A Cirrus Vision Jet suffered gear collapse during a closed-runway takeoff in Idaho, injuring one passenger.",

-          "A Cirrus Vision Jet sustained substantial damage and suffered a landing gear collapse during a takeoff attempt from a closed runway section at Driggs-Reed Memorial Airport (DIJ (DIJ)) in Idaho. Official statements confirm that one passenger on board was injured in the collision and was subsequently transported by ambulance to a local hospital for medical evaluation.",

+          "A Cirrus Vision Jet sustained substantial damage and suffered a landing gear collapse during a takeoff attempt from a closed runway section at Driggs-Reed Memorial Airport (DIJ) in Idaho. Official statements confirm that one passenger on board was injured in the collision and was subsequently transported by ambulance to a local hospital for medical evaluation.",

"According to details released by the City of Driggs, the accident occurred at approximately 06:30 local time on August 14, 2026, as the Vision Jet attempted to depart from Runway 4. "City authorities reported that the aircraft entered the closed area and attempted to take off through the portion of the runway under construction. Driggs Deputy City Administrator Doug Self stated that while the pilot was able to slow the plane upon approaching the construction site, a collision with construction materials could not be averted. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) added that the jet struck gravel on the closed section, resulting in the collapse of its landing gear.",

"FAA records identify the aircraft by registration N71KD, registered to Vision71 Technologies based in Chevy Chase, Maryland. Airport officials noted that Driggs-Reed Memorial Airport operates as a non-towered facility and that pilots had been advised of the construction work several weeks prior to the start of the project. A formal Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) outlining the partial runway closure was officially issued on August 5.",

"title": "Electra tests ultra-STOL aircraft as feeder for major airports",

-        "summary": "Electra announced on August 18, 2026 that it conducted demonstration flights of its ultra-short takeoff and landing (STOL) hybrid-electric aircraft to test feasibility as a feeder for major airports; the program was run under the FAA-backed eVTOL Integration Pilot Program, with support from PennDOT and NJDOT, flying from Manassas, Virginia to Philadelphia International Airport (PHL) (PNE)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   with stops at Millville Executive (MIV), Atlantic City Bader Field (AIY) and Northeast Philadelphia .",

+        "summary": "Electra tested its ultra-STOL hybrid-electric aircraft as a feeder for major airports, flying from Manassas to Philadelphia International Airport (PHL) with stops at Millville Executive Airport (MIV), Atlantic City Bader Field (AIY), and Northeast Philadelphia Airport (PNE).",

"Electra, a startup developing an ultra-short takeoff and landing (STOL) hybrid-electric aircraft, announced on August 18, 2026 that it has conducted a series of demonstration flights testing the capability of this novel aircraft to operate as a feeder for major airports.",

"The flight program took place under the aegis of the eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP), backed by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), and also saw support from the Department of Transportation of two states: Pennsylvania and New Jersey.",
-          "The flight program began at Electra’s base in Manassas, Virginia and made its final stop at Philadelphia International Airport , Pennsylvania.",

-          "Along the way, Electra’s “Goldfinch” demonstrator stopped at several small regional airports: Millville Executive Airport                                                                                                                                                                    and Atlantic City Bader Field (AIY), both in New Jersey, and Northeast Philadelphia Airport , Pennsylvania.",
+          "The flight program began at Electra’s base in Manassas, Virginia and made its final stop at Philadelphia International Airport (PHL), Pennsylvania.",

+          "Along the way, Electra’s “Goldfinch” demonstrator stopped at several small regional airports: Millville Executive Airport (MIV) and Atlantic City Bader Field (AIY), both in New Jersey, and Northeast Philadelphia Airport (PNE), Pennsylvania.",

"One of the key aims of the project was to test the integration of small hybrid-electric aircraft like Electra’s, which is designed to provide air network capillarity by servicing multiple small, underused airfields in the US national airspace management system.",

"“Electra’s Ultra Short aircraft can create direct connections between communities, regional airports, and major hubs, unlocking a faster, more accessible way to travel,” said Marc Allen, Electra’s CEO, in a press release announcing the milestone.",

"In parallel to this initiative, Electra currently has other projects underway to test its technology in real operational conditions, including a demonstration flight program in Florida with that state’s Department of Transportation and private-sector partners, a project with Signature Aviation and Vertiports by Atlantic to assess suitability of its ultra-STOL aircraft for heliport operations in the New York/New Jersey area, and another testing program in Louisiana together with Bristow Group."

"summary": "A NetJets Citation Longitude made a nose-gear-up emergency landing in Ohio; two pilots were uninjured.",

The flight was operating as NetJets Flight EJA803 from Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) to Akron-Canton when its nose landing gear failed to extend during arrival.",

"According to video footage of the landing, the aircraft touched down on its main landing gear first. The pilots held the nose off the runway surface for several seconds as the aircraft decelerated before the nose settled onto the pavement. diffLines: +# SKYTICAL Logo 規格與重現方式
+本文件定義 SKYTICAL 網站的唯一 Logo 母版、色票、裁切方式與衍生資產。未來更新 Logo 時，必須以 `SKYTICAL-master.svg` 為唯一來源，禁止重新描圖、替換字型或手動調整各個輸出檔。
+- 自訂字元：倒 V／希臘 Lambda `Λ`，不可改成一般字母 `A`
+- 構圖：左側三層掠翼，右側主字標，標語置於主字標下方
+- 背景：正式 Logo 必須透明；`#F3F2F2` 僅可用於預覽與社群分享圖
+| 用途 | 色號 | 名稱 |
+| 機翼上層 | `#EC3013` | Aviation Warning Red |
+| 預覽／社群背景 | `#F3F2F2` | Preview Grey |
+- 來源：2026-08-11 由 Canva 匯出的使用者核准版本
+母版文字已轉成 SVG 路徑，不依賴外部字型。Canva 將機翼圖層以內嵌 PNG 儲存在 SVG 中，因此這份檔案雖然是 SVG 容器，機翼本身不是純向量；邊緣抗鋸齒像素可能不是單一標準色。重現時應保留內嵌影像，不得重新取樣、描圖或套用濾鏡。
+| 檔案 | 尺寸／裁切 | 用途 |
+| `static/skytical-mark.svg` | `220 × 220`；`viewBox="250 650 250 220"` | favicon 與結構化資料 Logo |
+| `static/skytical-social.png` | `1200 × 630`，Logo 為 `1000 × 220` 並置中 | Open Graph／X 分享圖 |
+橫式 Logo 與翼標的產生規則只有兩項：
+1. 從母版移除 `#FFFFFF` 與 `#F3F2F2` 的兩個全畫布 `<rect>`，使背景透明。
+2. 只修改根 `<svg>` 的輸出尺寸與 `viewBox`，不得修改任何 Logo 圖層、路徑、遮罩、位置或比例。
+社群分享圖使用 `#F3F2F2` 的 `1200 × 630` 畫布，將透明橫式 Logo 以 `1000 × 220` 尺寸置於 `(100, 205)`。
+- `SKYTICΛL` 與標語拼字完全一致，`Λ` 不得變成 `A`。
+- 三層機翼順序固定為紅、橘、金；不得反轉、混色或套用漸層、陰影與濾鏡。
+- 頁首、頁尾、favicon、結構化資料與社群分享圖均來自同一母版。
+- 橫式與翼標 SVG 背景透明，不含白色或灰色背景矩形。
+- 桌機與手機版均維持原有容器尺寸，不因母版的方形畫布產生額外空白。
+- 母版 SHA-256 必須與本文件相同；若不同，應視為新的品牌版本並同步更新本文件、衍生資產與快取版本。

Fabrication tripwire + honest handling of thin derivative items

Owner spotted that the Delta flight-attendant-pay article's body claimed
the (unseen) Simple Flying piece "詳細分析…引述公司內部文件…比較新舊合約"
- the RSS material was one sentence, so that paragraph was invented.
Facts passed the verbatim-quote check; body prose had no gate. Now:

- Corrected the published article + its briefing copies in place to
  supported-only content (the other two SF-derived articles audited
  clean).
- SYSTEM_PROMPT: derivative items may state only publisher/date/title
  and what the shown excerpt itself says; describing unseen article
  contents is named as machine-checked fabrication; reject instead of
  padding. Self-check gains item (8).
- write.fabrication_problem(): for groups with NO fulltext, drafts using
  tell-tale sourcing verbs (內部文件/詳細分析/引述/知情人士/據悉...)
  absent from the material are rejected like a validation failure; the
  flight path gets the same gate. Fulltext groups are exempt - long
  bodies legitimately describe actually-shown quotes.
- Simple Flying full text is contractually OFF-LIMITS: Valnet's
  robots.txt terms explicitly ban automated text/data-mining and AI use
  of page content. Pinned as a comment in fulltext.py (never allowlist)
  + a test asserting simpleflying stays out of ALLOWED_HOSTS. Their RSS
  excerpt remains the ceiling for those items.
- data/fulltext.json is no longer committed (media page text does not
  belong in a public repo); the cache is per-run now, budget unchanged.

-      "text": "聯合防禦操演 驗證直屬參謀本部戰略預備隊應變能量
（中央社記者 游凱翔 台北26日電）國軍聯合防禦操演日前結束，知情人士指出，此次操演已驗證直屬參謀本部的戰略預備隊應變能量；學者推測，在漢光實兵等聯合作戰想定下，由具備跨海陸空機動能力的部隊擔任戰略預備隊，成為關鍵打擊戰力。
共軍近年不斷對台文攻武嚇，以機艦侵擾台灣周邊海空域，並不時逾越台海中線、在周邊區域舉行軍演；國軍除持續國造及對外籌獲軍備，也強化訓練力度及制度改革，因應可能的潛在威脅。
知情人士表示，由不同單位各自擔當的戰略預備隊直屬於參謀本部，由參謀總長指揮，為國軍關鍵力量之一，在7月13日至17日舉行的聯合防禦操演，已驗證相關能量。
國防部智庫、國防安全研究院學者蘇紫雲接受中央社訪問時說明，戰略預備隊是軍事作戰上的核心組織結構，例如一個旅下轄3個營時，指揮官通常會運用2個營在第一線交戰，保留一個營當作「戰術活棋」；且預備隊非消極等待，而是保持戰術彈性，在第一線遭突破時進行快反、增援角色，發揮反突防、填補缺口作用。
蘇紫雲指出，在台海防衛戰略，戰略預備隊不受單一戰區轄制。根據國防部先前披露的公開資訊，配備AH-64E阿帕契攻擊直升機的陸航601旅，部分單位即直屬參謀本部；另外，具備高速機動能力、能跨越水陸空界面的單位，乃至於空軍聯隊與部分海軍兵力，均能在戰略預備隊想定中扮演重要角色。
蘇紫雲推測，在漢光實兵等聯合作戰想定下，戰略預備隊已不再局限於單一陸上打擊，而是涵蓋陸海空軍戰力，屆時將於關鍵時刻鞏固並確保政經核心、關鍵基礎設施的安全。（編輯：林克倫）1150726

-      "text": "蔡其昌率團赴台灣日僑宴 前紐約市長亞當斯出席支持
（中央社記者 廖漢原 紐約25日專電）美國職棒大聯盟紐約大都會台灣日明天舉行，擔任雙開球嘉賓的美國國家航空暨太空總署太空人林琪兒及中華職棒大聯盟會長蔡其昌等，今天出席賽前僑宴，前紐約市長亞當斯出席對台僑社群表達支持。
第22屆大都會台灣日將於26日在紐約大都會主場花旗球場（Citi Field）舉行，擔任開雙球嘉賓的美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）太空人林琪兒（Kjell Lindgren）及中華職棒大聯盟會長蔡其昌，25日聯袂出席於台僑聚集的法拉盛（Flushing）地區僑宴。
先前訪問華府拜會美國國會及行政部門，參加智庫研討會的立委吳思瑤、沈伯洋、陳培瑜及王定宇，同場出席活動。
林琪兒以太空望向地球的經驗向紐約台僑表示，相信在座的人對台灣都有那種連結感受，很高興年初回台連結出生地，有機會探視朋友與熟悉的地方，協助台灣與美國建立關係，包括教育、官方或產業方面。
他指出，台灣是旅程開始的地方，自己擁有台灣與美國背景讓人感動。台美是經濟夥伴關係，彼此也分享民主、自由、創新與機會。
蔡其昌表示，棒球是台灣的國球，棒球團結台灣這個國家。在棒球場上無論是支持藍綠白，不會互相嫌棄、對立、討厭。在棒球場上只要是棒球迷，都會暫時忘掉台灣社會內部不同政治主張的紛爭，團結一致為台灣加油。
他說，棒球讓全世界看到台灣，台灣在世界棒球12強高張力、高難度的比賽拿下世界冠軍，讓全世界看到台灣，這就是棒球的魅力。
參選台北市長的沈伯洋指出，台灣民主確實有點跌跌撞撞，30年來遇到很多挑戰，我們撐到現在，這是台灣民主可貴的地方。
他說，今天講到總觀效應，即在太空往下看，看不到國界，但看得到每個城市的燈光，城市燈光相連。希望那是民主、熱情的燈光，希望未來台北的燈光越來越亮，能夠與世界主要城市連結，讓這燈光以台北與各國首都為首，照亮整個民主世界。
活躍於亞裔社群的前紐約市長亞當斯（Eric Adams）也出席晚宴，與沈伯洋等人會晤合照。
亞當斯表示，（台裔）社群對紐約市極重要，在任期間花很多時間在此。（台裔）社區相信家庭、營商、公共安全並支持警力，這很重要。大家多次相聚攜手合作，對城市做出更多貢獻，所以今天到場表達支持。許多人知道晶片力量來自台灣，台灣社群對紐約市具有重要性。
訪團一行人期間出席沈伯洋在法拉盛舉行的紐約海外後援會成立大會，許多台僑到場展現支持。（編輯：唐佩君）1150726

9e13218902589b08ad93116d8dca2fc261bf4580.message:
Briefings v2: owner's Perplexity format + Taiwan mil/transport sources

Recreates the owner's Perplexity daily-report inside the pipeline's own
rules - the model still never searches the web; instead the owner's
search list became scheduled fetch queries:

- New sources: Simple Flying (official RSS), CNA politics wire
  (official feedburner feed + new per-source keyword filter in fetch.py
  so only aviation/military-air/transport items survive - 3/20 kept on
  the live probe), MND/軍聞社 via Google News proxy (direct RSS is 403),
  and a Taiwan rail/metro/maritime Google News query. CNA + MND hosts
  added to the fulltext allowlist (robots still honored).
- Briefing format per the owner's template: ✈️ title, emoji section
  headers (🚨 flight safety / 🇹🇼 Taiwan civil+military / 🌐 industry /
  🚄 ground & maritime), per-item severity marks (⚠️/🔴), 🇹🇼 and ⚔️
  flags from the stored item metadata, 📡 sources block, and a
  conservative per-section empty note (never "nothing happened
  worldwide" claims - the owner's own briefing spec bans those).
- Classification dictionaries extended: 共機/中共機艦/解放軍 → military
  flag, 國防部/臺海 → Taiwan, 小三通/船班/出軌 → ground & maritime.

Not done, by design: no Perplexity output is ever ingested and no model
performs its own web search - both are banned by the owner's briefing
spec (sections 1 and 19) and the published methodology page.

tests: test_briefing.py 58 checks (classification + marks); all 8
suites green; live fetch probe of every new feed succeeded.

Rare-aircraft observations auto-publish through a machine gate

Owner policy change (2026-07-27): routine rare-aircraft observation
items no longer wait for a human. write.py now publishes a drafted
flight event directly when ALL of these hold:

- ADS-B sources are not in conflict (crossCheck != conflicting_sources)
- the draft is not safety-flavoured (cat != safety, incident == null,
  no accident/casualty/investigation/conflict risk flags)
- validation and verbatim-quote verification passed as before

Anything else still goes to data/review.json exactly as promised on the
public methodology page (safety events remain human-gated). Repo var
FLIGHT_AUTO_PUBLISH=false restores review-everything behaviour; the
flight prompt no longer asks the model to mention any review workflow
inside article text (publication policy is code's job, not the
model's).

tests: test_flightwatch.py reworked - auto-publish happy path, conflict
gate, safety-flag gate, kill switch; all 8 suites green.

e817e0b43b3fdf43d1ce5fad41023e52e1440213.message:
Auto-match real photos to articles (free, keyless, embedded)

New pipeline/images.py stage (hourly, after write.py): articles gain a
real matching photo embedded from an external origin, or honestly none.

- Tier 1: Planespotters.net public photos API by aircraft registration
  found in verified article text -> a photo of the SAME airframe
  (labelled 同機資料照片), with photographer credit and backlink.
- Tier 2: Wikimedia Commons search from verified entities only
  (airline + type family / type / airline / airport, via the existing
  config dictionaries). Only CC/public-domain results whose file title
  matches the entity tokens are accepted; credit, license and source
  link render under the image. Labelled 資料照片（非事件現場照片）—
  never presented as an event photo.
- No API keys, no paid services, no model calls; lookups are capped per
  run and cached in data/images.json (negative results retry 3x max).
  Network failure skips silently - the pipeline never fails over a
  photo. Conservative registration regex (plain "N95" never matches).
- build.normalize_image() renders dict/legacy-string images uniformly;
  hero and article pages show the credit line wherever the image shows.
- tests/test_images.py: 21 offline checks, all HTTP mocked.

54cc76080f33b526718d025ad1c5852309811c59.message:
Thrice-daily air & transport briefings (fixed Taipei windows)

New pipeline/briefing.py assembles a briefing three times a day from
articles the hourly pipeline already verified and published - no new
fetching, no new APIs, no per-item model calls. Editions use fixed
half-open Asia/Taipei windows (morning 23:00->07:00, afternoon
07:00->15:00, evening 15:00->23:00) derived only from edition + date,
so a delayed Actions run never shifts the window.

- config/briefing_editions.json: single source of truth for labels,
  windows, cutoffs and crons; CRON_TO_EDITION mirrors briefing.yml.
- Cross-edition event dedup via data/briefings/event_index.json
  (SHA-256 fingerprint over section/entities/locations/idents/event
  date; source URLs kept as alternate match keys, never hashed, so
  reprints dedupe). Substantive new facts -> item_type=update with
  new_information from verified fact claims; retitles/reprints skip.
- Deterministic assembly by default (generation_mode=deterministic,
  generation_model=null). Optional single batch intro call gated by
  BRIEFING_LLM_INTRO, capped by BRIEFING_EXTRA_LLM_CALLS_MAX=1; any
  failure falls back without failing the edition. Zero items = zero
  calls.
- Failure protection: failed runs never touch briefing files and never
  downgrade an already-successful edition; source-fetch failures mark
  the edition partial with coverage warnings instead of reading as "no
  events"; the conservative empty-edition copy never claims the world
  was quiet.
- Site: /briefings/ index + per-edition pages (zh/en), nav entry, and
  a homepage "latest briefing" box chosen by cutoff_time (failed rows
  ignored).
- .github/workflows/briefing.yml: three UTC crons with explicit
  schedule->edition mapping, dispatch with edition/date inputs,
  briefing-group concurrency, same secret scan and commit/deploy
  pattern as hourly.yml (commits only data/briefings; no workflow
  loop).
- tests/test_briefing.py: 53 offline checks (windows/boundaries/cron
  mapping/dedup/updates/call caps/fallbacks/failure protection/latest
  selection/no-paid-API scans).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

f2a0da18d7de53380a2715f194289c86a077019b.message:
Taiwan rare-aircraft arrival detection (OFF by default) + source-copy fix

New parallel pipeline, zero impact on the RSS news flow:
- pipeline/adsb.py: Airplanes.live (primary, ONE wide-area query/run,
  radius capped 250nm, 429 backs off, failure = "unknown sky" never
  "empty sky") + ADSB.lol (secondary, candidates only). v2 field
  sanitization: t vs type separation, alt_baro "ground", callsign trim,
  ~non-ICAO, stale seen_pos, ground vehicles; military/PIA/LADD/
  emergency aircraft excluded with no trajectory retention.
- pipeline/flightwatch.py: per-aircraft/airport track state machine
  (observed/approaching/probable/confirmed/overflight; ground-state or
  multi-point descending evidence only - a single snapshot or an
  overflight can never "arrive"), explainable 0-100 rarity scoring
  driven by config + arrival history with a 30-day bootstrap that
  forbids rarity claims on an empty history, cross-source confirmation
  (two-source/primary-only/conflicting/unavailable), stable event ids
  sha256(hex|airport|date) against 5-minute rerun duplicates, and
  atomic state under data/flightwatch/ committed only when changed.
- pipeline/flightnews.py + prompts/rare-aircraft-news-zh.txt: quotable
  <SOURCE type="flight_observation"> assembler (identities, times,
  counts - never coordinates) and the conservative-attribution prompt.
- write.py: consumes the queue after RSS groups (0 AI calls when
  empty), same provider chain/validation/verify_facts, and FORCES every
  drafted event into data/review.json manual review; attribution links
  (Airplanes.live / ADSB.lol) become the article's sources on approval.
- .github/workflows/rare-aircraft-monitor.yml: */5 cron + dispatch,
  gated on FLIGHT_TRACKING_ENABLED, concurrency-locked, commits state
  only on change (hourly.yml ignores data/** pushes - no loops).
- config/: tw_civil_airports.json (17 civil airports incl. islands,
  validated: ICAO/IATA/ranges/dup detection), airline_icao_codes.json,
  aircraft_types.json, rare_aircraft_watchlist.json (DAL+A359+RCKH test
  rule), normal_airport_operations.json overlay.
- tests/test_flightwatch.py: 74 offline checks (parsing, sensitive
  exclusion, state machine, cross-check, rarity+bootstrap, event ids,
  config validation, SOURCE privacy, review-queue integration, zero-AI
  idle path, publication delay).

Also: sources-page copy reworded per the owner (public + traceable
authoritative sources, not "free sources").

Per-model reasoning profiles, DeepSeek V4 Pro slot, freshness/observability overhaul

MODEL_PROFILES (pipeline/providers.py) is the single source of truth for
model ids, reasoning controls and sampling:
- nemotron-3-ultra: chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking + medium_effort
- nemotron-3-super: reasoning_effort low (default reasoning ate the whole
  8192-token budget in live runs and truncated every draft)
- deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro: reasoning_effort high; wired at chain #3
  (not in this key's catalog yet - 404 falls through until NVIDIA opens it)
- qwen3.5: enable_thinking + thinking-mode sampling (0.6/0.95/20/0.0)
- glm-5.2: provider-default reasoning, no invented fields on the wire
- mistral-medium-3.5: reasoning_effort high (last fallback, quality first)
- gemini-3.6/3.5-flash: thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel medium, temp 0.1

Reasoning traces are now provably separated from final answers: Gemini
thought-parts and NIM reasoning_content never reach the JSON parser,
published data or logs. Malformed JSON gets ONE no-thinking format-repair
call (syntax only; content failures still fail over per policy). NIM read
timeout raised to 180s (550B models regularly exceeded 120s).

Freshness/observability per the editorial ops spec:
- NEWS_MAX_AGE_HOURS in common.py (default 120, validated 24-336,
  warning + safe fallback on bad values) replaces the 48h constant
- future-dated items dropped beyond 6h clock skew, before any AI call
- items without a source date carry dateInferred; the prompt shows them
  as first-seen stamps, never as publication times
- articles record sourcePublishedUtc (newest real source date); the site
  displays it instead of generation time, with m/d labels for older news
- title-echo summaries no longer count as material (item_has_material)
- dedupe ranks material-bearing groups above title-only ones so thin rows
  cannot crowd real stories out of the cap; per-run skip-reason stats
- write logs ai_calls per model; CI scans build output for secret-like
  strings and reasoning traces before deploy

Tests: 51 provider payload/parsing checks (all mocked), 121 write checks,
6 dedupe suites incl. freshness window, future guard and material ranking.

Model-level routing chain per the owner's API policy

AVWIRE_PROVIDER_ORDER tokens may now pin a model (nvidia:nvidia/
nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b) and repeat a platform with different
models, so same-platform fallbacks (Ultra -> Super) and cross-platform
ones (-> Gemini -> Qwen on NIM) interleave freely. Policy semantics:
the primary model gets one retry on validation/quote failures; an
account-level auth or quota death disables every model on that
platform (shared key) and routing jumps to the next platform; reject
and manual_review never switch providers.

Boxed centered layout: 1280px content sheet with side gutters

The page chrome, home grid, and footer previously spanned the full
viewport (inner containers capped at 1440px), which read as cramped on
wide screens. The .page wrapper is now the single width authority: a
centered 1280px sheet with hairline side borders and a soft shadow over
a darker body gutter (color-mix keeps it theme-aware in dark mode).
Home rails narrowed 280/320 -> 260/300 to give the center column room.
Below 1100px the sheet goes edge-to-edge again.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

AVWIRE initial implementation: pipeline (fetch/dedupe/write/build), Modernist templates, hourly GitHub Actions workflow [skip ci]

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
diffLines: +    - cron: "0 * * * *" # every hour on the hour (UTC)
+      - "data/**" # bot data commits must not retrigger the workflow
+全自動航空新聞聚合站。GitHub Actions 每小時整點抓取 FAA / NTSB / ICAO / IATA /
+EASA / Eurocontrol / Reuters / The Aviation Herald / 交通部民航局等免費可信來源，
+去重合併後由 LLM 自動撰寫雙語（繁中 + EN）新聞稿，產出靜態頁面並部署到
+GitHub Pages。每篇文章文末列出所有原始來源連結。
+A fully automated aviation news aggregator: fetch trusted free sources hourly,
+de-duplicate, draft bilingual stories with an LLM, publish as a static site on
+GitHub Pages — with every original source credited at the end of each article.
+│  ├─ common.py     # 共用設定與來源註冊表
+│  ├─ CONTRACTS.md  # 各階段 JSON 資料契約
+│  ├─ fetch.py      # 抓取 RSS / HTML / API → data/raw/
+│  ├─ dedupe.py     # URL 正規化 + 標題相似度去重、跨來源合併 → data/pending.json
+│  ├─ write.py      # Anthropic API 撰稿（zh+en）→ data/articles/、flashes、incidents
+├─ templates/       # Jinja2 模板（Modernist 設計系統）
+├─ data/            # 原始快照與文章 JSON（commit 進 repo 當作資料庫）
+└─ site/            # 輸出，部署到 GitHub Pages
+1. Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions：新增 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
+   （撰稿用，必要）與 `AEROAPI_KEY`（FlightAware 統計，選用）。
+3. Actions 頁手動觸發一次 `hourly-update` 驗證。
+沒有 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` 時管線仍會執行：抓取與建站照常，只是不產生新文章。
+AVWIRE_BASE_PATH= python pipeline/build.py       # 本機預覽用空 base path
